stories.title: L’allarme degli 007: “Mosca vuole uccidere i leader della Difesa europei”

en.title: Intelligence alert: "Moscow wants to kill European Defense leaders"
en.summary: European intelligence services report that Russia's military intelligence agency GRU has launched plans to assassinate defense industry leaders across the continent, according to information gathered by the Financial Times.

stories.title: Allarme 007, Mosca intensifica tentativi di assassinare vertici della difesa europea

en.title: Intelligence alert: Moscow intensifies attempts to assassinate European defense officials
en.summary: Security measures around senior defense officials have been increased as Moscow escalates efforts to target European defense leadership, according to reports.

stories.title: MotoGP Indonesia: Bezzecchi trionfa nella gara. Martin di nuovo leader del Mondiale

en.title: MotoGP Indonesia: Bezzecchi triumphs in race. Martin retakes World Championship lead
en.summary: Bezzecchi secured a historic fourth victory for Aprilia in Indonesia, while Martin regained the championship lead with a two-point advantage over Marquez, who won the Sprint race.

stories.title: Bezzecchi domina in Indonesia, Martin di nuovo leader mondiale, Marc Marquez solo sesto

en.title: Bezzecchi dominates in Indonesia, Martin retakes world lead, Marc Marquez finishes sixth
en.summary: Bezzecchi claimed Aprilia's fourth win at Mandalika, defeating Fernandez and Martin, who reclaimed the championship lead with a two-point advantage over the Ducati rider.

stories.title: Casini: "Lascio il Parlamento, dopo 44 anni non mi ricandido, ma la politica non si abbandona"

en.title: Casini: "I'm leaving Parliament, after 44 years I won't run again, but I'm not abandoning politics"
en.summary: A longtime Catholic politician announced his departure from Parliament after 44 years, stating he will not seek reelection while maintaining his commitment to political engagement.

stories.title: Aprilia, poker storico in Indonesia: Bezzecchi vince e Martin torna leader della MotoGP

en.title: Aprilia, historic four-pack in Indonesia: Bezzecchi wins and Martin returns to MotoGP lead
en.summary: Aprilia placed four motorcycles in the top four positions in MotoGP for the first time. Bezzecchi took victory while Martin maintained the championship lead despite a finger fracture.

stories.title: L’annuncio di Casini: “Dopo 44 anni dirò addio al Parlamento”

en.title: Casini announces: "After 44 years I will say goodbye to Parliament"
en.summary: The former Chamber president announced his parliamentary departure, emphasizing the difficulty of leaving while doing so with dignity, as speculation continues about his potential candidacy for the presidency.

stories.title: Raid Houthi sull'aeroporto di Riad: terminal colpito

en.title: Houthi raid on Riyadh airport: terminal hit
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked Riyadh airport, causing flight disruptions and prompting concern from Western governments. Trump is considering military intervention alongside Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Autorità, almeno 309 i feriti nell'attacco degli Houthi all'aeroporto di Riad

en.title: Authorities: At least 309 injured in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Civil aviation authorities report that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport resulted in at least 309 people injured.

stories.title: Nyt, 'almeno 12 morti nell'attacco degli houthi all'aeroporto di Riad'

en.title: NYT: At least 12 dead in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: The New York Times reports that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed at least 12 people, with at least 50 others wounded.

stories.title: Raid Houthi sull’Arabia Saudita, strage all’aeroporto di Riad: 12 morti

en.title: Houthi raid on Saudi Arabia, massacre at Riyadh airport: 12 dead
en.summary: Yemeni rebel forces launched an attack on King Khalid airport in Riyadh, resulting in casualties and injuries. Over 300 people were wounded in the incident.

stories.title: Riad, missile Houthi sull’aeroporto: 12 morti e 300 feriti. Trump: “Potremmo unirci ai raid sauditi”

en.title: Riyadh, Houthi missile hits airport: 12 dead and 300 wounded. Trump: "We could join Saudi raids"
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh's airport resulted in casualties and flight suspensions, with projectiles also fired near Dammam airport. The U.S. president indicated potential involvement in military operations.

stories.title: La milanese Medisolve rileva l’austriaca Mides

en.title: Milan-based Medisolve acquires Austrian Mides
en.summary: Medisolve, a Milan-based company backed by private equity firm HIG Capital and a European leader in biomedical equipment management and maintenance services, has acquired Mides.

stories.title: Caccia ai talenti dell’AI: quanto costano e quanto rendono alle imprese italiane

en.title: Hunting for AI talent: costs and returns for Italian companies
en.summary: Italian companies specializing in artificial intelligence are willing to pay significantly more for personnel compared to similar companies, seeking young talent with AI expertise.

stories.title: Ex Ilva: «Stop per l’ordine dei giudici e perché siamo senza materie prime»

en.title: Ex Ilva: "Stoppage due to court order and lack of raw materials"
en.summary: The company cited unrealistic conditions imposed by magistrates within 90 days and stated it halted purchasing for production due to anticipated plant closure.

stories.title: Tatuaggi e piercing, imprese più che raddoppiate in 10 anni

en.title: Tattoos and piercings, businesses more than doubled in 10 years
en.summary: Tattoo and piercing businesses in Italy increased by 160 percent between 2017 and 2026, with Rome leading in absolute numbers and Bari showing the fastest growth rate.

stories.title: L’export resiste alla crisi energetica. Diversificare chiave per la crescita

en.title: Exports resist energy crisis. Diversification key for growth
en.summary: A Promos Italia white paper examines Italian export trends between 2021 and 2026, analyzing how exports have performed through economic and geopolitical challenges.
